facebook.content:
“**Matthew 6:33** — ‘But seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be added to you.’  

The world promises security in wealth, status, or safety. The Kingdom, however, demands our priority now, not tomorrow. When we place God’s reign above every agenda, the provision we need is already guaranteed.  

What Kingdom priority will you claim today?”
